resolution.note: armEnv drops scripts/app-bin PATH entries; replay-live gh identity test passes on a host whose PATH starts with app-bin

title: Arm sessions inherit the GitHub App gh wrapper from PATH
body:
On 2026-11-17 test/evals/replay-live.test.ts 'an arm session env carries no GitHub identity' fails on main on this host: armEnv (evals/replay/live.ts) keeps the host PATH, whose first entry is scripts/app-bin, the gh wrapper that mints a GitHub App installation token. So an arm A session can run gh pr view/diff -R <upstream> authenticated and read the upstream fix (the S7 leak the test guards), and every fast check touching replay-live is red on the host.
Outcome: armEnv drops every PATH entry that is a scripts/app-bin directory, so gh in an arm session is the real gh with an empty config.
Proof: node --test test/evals/replay-live.test.ts passes on a host whose PATH starts with scripts/app-bin; a unit test asserts the arm PATH has no app-bin entry.
